title: The Logic of Factor Portfolios: Boolean Rules, Interactions, and Trading Costs
abstract: arXiv:2611.09834v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Investors turn signals into holdings through decision rules: buy the top decile, hold stocks with high momentum and low volatility, exclude stocks that fail a screen. Many such rules are Boolean functions of threshold statements about signal ranks, and writing them this way shows both what a rule holds and how often it trades. A Walsh decomposition splits the return of any rule into exposures to individual signals and to interactions among signals; an intersection and a union of the same two screens, for example, have opposite interaction exposures. The same coefficients, together with the persistence of the underlying statements, determine turnover. Interactions are less persistent than their components, so rules that load on higher-order interactions trade more, and thresholds discard information, so at equal risk threshold implementations of interactions trade more than smooth ones. translated_title: 因子组合的逻辑：布尔规则、交互作用与交易成本
translated_abstract: 投资者通过决策规则将信号转化为持仓：例如买入排名最高的十分位股票、持有高动量且低波动率的股票、排除未通过筛选条件的股票。许多此类规则是关于信号排序阈值命题的布尔函数，而以这种方式书写规则，既能展示规则持有什么资产，也能展示其交易频率。沃尔什（Walsh）分解可将任何规则的收益分解为对单个信号的暴露以及对信号间交互作用的暴露；例如，对相同两个筛选条件取交集与取并集，二者具有相反的交互作用暴露。这些相同的系数连同底层命题的持续性，共同决定了换手率。由于交互作用的持续性低于其组成成分，加载于高阶交互作用的规则交易更频繁；又由于阈值会丢弃信息，在同等风险下，交互作用的阈值实现比平滑实现交易更频繁。在1973年至2024年的美国股票市场中，这些预测得到了验证。
tldr: 该论文将因子投资的决策规则表示为信号排序阈值命题的布尔函数，利用沃尔什分解将规则收益分解为单信号暴露与交互作用暴露，并证明交互作用持续性更低导致更高换手率，从而从规则逻辑结构出发解释了交易成本的来源。
en_tdlr: This paper expresses factor investing decision rules as Boolean functions of threshold statements about signal ranks, uses a Walsh decomposition to split rule returns into individual-signal and interaction exposures, and shows that lower persistence of interactions implies higher turnover, thereby linking the logical structure of rules to trading costs.
